seed: Spilled my coffee on the way to work

# I Spilled My Coffee and Rebuilt My Entire Worldview

I almost didn't share this.

But I'm humbled by how many of you asked.

This morning, I spilled my flat white on the pavement.

I cried a little.

Not because of the coffee.

Because in that moment, I realised I was just a regular guy with a very large vision.

Here's what it taught me about leadership:

✅ Great leaders don't cry over spilt milk. They cry over spilt oat milk, quietly, then pivot.

🚀 Every puddle is a pipeline.

💡 If you can't hold a cup, hold your team accountable.

🙏 Gratitude is just caffeine for the soul.

I'm not saying I'm a visionary.

I'm just saying the pavement hasn't been the same since.

Agree?
